scores.tell: Candelabra is glossy metal with sharp specular streaks and strong dark-to-bright banding on the stem and arms. Flame glow and a hard base highlight read as shiny, statue-like. There is no cast shadow.

Painterly, flat 2D illustration. Light turns softly with little form shading, and the pool rings have only airy gradients. The fence shadow and grass blades are illustrative. It lacks the real cards' soft 3D volume.

Wagon has a painterly, scenic look with gentle form shading and a soft cast shadow, but it is not the smooth clay-like 3D of the real cards. Wheel spokes and canvas are lightly textured, similar to the grade 2 wagon lesson.

Phone booth has smooth form turn and a soft cast shadow, but the glass panes show flat, slightly generic highlights. The booth's side shadow is somewhat heavy and uniform, and the floor shadow is a hard blob.

Dock and water are painterly, with busy caustics and sharp wave highlights across the whole card. The posts have a flat gradient. It is a scene illustration, not the smooth sculpted object lighting of the real cards.
Fins have soft broad sheen, smooth form turn and gentle bounce. There is a soft contact shadow, with no hot spots. Close to the real cards; the only small tell is that the shadow is faint.
Gloves have a broad soft sheen and smooth turning, but the highlight on the left glove is slightly glossy and bright. The wood floor shadows are fine and the contact shadow is good.
Flip-flops have smooth, rounded, clay-like form turn with soft broad highlights on the straps and nubs. The cast shadow is gentle. Very close to the real cards.
Boot has smooth soft form turn, a broad sheen and a gentle core shadow. It has no ground or cast shadow, so it floats, and the overall shading range is slightly low and flat.
Broom has smooth bristle volume with soft highlights on the handle. The shading is gentle and clean. There is no cast shadow, and the bristle highlights are a little uniform.
